item.title: Son of Zambian bishop detained in post-election raid fears for his father's safety
item.description: Trevor Mwamba was detained last month with other opposition figures and charged with treason, his son says.

item.title: Tigray capital 'out of cash' as fighting escalates, resident tells BBC
item.description: A resident of Mekelle says the city is calm but people are stressed after the outbreak of fighting in the region.
